findings.finding: tasks.md T-001–006 Done When and Global constraints require generic Red→Green/independent review but omit the mandatory pre-implementation failing-test commit and recording a named reviewer distinct from the implementer. A downstream task can satisfy the written completion items without those required high/critical controls. Add explicit planned completion evidence for both; this is a Critical mandatory-evidence omission.

tasks.md T-001–005 have no Rollback field or rollback-related Done When item. infra-spec.md Rollback is not referenced as task-level completion evidence. Require safe-reversion evidence appropriate to each change, preserving expiry filtering and residual cleanup; otherwise high/critical completion lacks a verifiable rollback consideration.

tasks.md T-005 blocks on T-004 lifecycle adapters without identifying a consumed adapter artifact. Its cleanup/registry/shared-lock scope depends on T-001–003, and design.md Architecture gives the OS oneshot a direct cleanup invocation. The blocker unnecessarily postpones retention implementation until both hosts' lifecycle work completes. Bind the blocker to actual required producer artifacts or state the missing logical dependency.
